avis.texte: I have severe blepharitis, chronic inflammation, and severe dry eye. I have tried so many eye creams, serums, gels, etc and most of them only irritated my eyes more. My dermatologist introduced me to the Avene skincare line and although not all their products were right for me, this particular eye cream helps soothe my eyes a lot. It didn't irritate and burn my eyes like the other products did. It also seems to help reduce undereye wrinkles stemming from dried out skin, itching, and overall smooth out the delicate eye area. I use this after my moisturizer twice a day and although it unfortunately has no affect on my dry eyes or blurry vision, it calms the surrounding skin from feeling pinched, dry, and painful.

***UPDATE*** I've changed my review to 5 stars. The problem wasn't the eye cream, but my skin. I found another eye cream that was my best option, but still wasn't excited about it. After some other face/skin issues I discovered other products from Avene. My under eye problem was eczema/extremely dry skin. I'm now using their Xeracalm as a base eye cream to handle the extreme dry skin. Then I use this Avene eye cream on top. My eyes look fresh, hydrated, and shiny. The dark circles are extemely minimized. As a test I went back to my old eye cream and while my eyes are hydrated (thanks to Xeracalm) they don't shine and the dark circles appear more noticeable. So there's something in the Avene eye cream that just illuminates the area and makes it appear brighter. I'm so glad (!!!) for my other skin issues so I could try this eye cream again. Now it's my favorite! I got this because it was in an article saying how wonderful it was for dry, sensitive skin. It doesn't make my eyes water (like others) and it's smooth and creamy. It just doesn't do anything special. I still have dry, flakey eyes after using concealer. It's nice, but too expensive for just a basic cream.

avis.titre: Love it but it's expensive. Got rid of my dermatitis. I'm subscribed.
avis.texte: The cost is kind of outrageous per oz. It's about twice as much as other eye creams on Amazon in the same search. But it's the best eye cream I've ever used. Now it all depends in what you expect from an eye cream. If you are looking for tightening this ain't it. Probably not for dark circles or puffiness either. I just need something great at moisturizing that doesn't cause irritation. Yes I'd love some help with aging skin but my skin is Sensitive and other eye creams caused irritation or just did nothing for me. I was having bouts of dermatitis on one of my eyelids. I didn't know what was causing it. At the time I was using Cerave. Just a simple straightforward eye cream. The Cerave I was using I assume wasnt the cause of the dermatitis BUT it didnt help it AND it did nothing else for me. There was no effect, no brightening and it it just felt boring putting it on. But this Avene eye cream cured my dermatitis! It does have a temporary brightening effect that I like and it's moisturizing. It's never irritated my skin or eyes. And it feels nice! It just glides on so smoothly. It feels luxurious. It's a great eye cream but is pricey! I also appreciate it coming in a tube. Eye creams in a tub isn't sanitary. The amount is smaller than the average amount other brands sell but it truly does stretch. A very small amount does wonders. I use this twice a day on both lower and upper eye areas and one tube lasts me 3 months. My eyes have truly never been this well moisturized. Other

I researched an eye cream that wouldn’t irritate my eyes, as I have very sensitive eyes, and they get red and water easily. I would say it’s worth it for the moisturizing effect, but it really still irritated my eyes. Wouldn’t re-purchase.

avis.titre: The only eye cream I can really recommend
avis.texte: At 67 I developed a sensitivity to many eye creams. Avene is the only one that soothed this sensitivity and has successfully kept eye wrinkles at bay for me. A huge plus is being able.to use it around the entire eye with no ill effects! I am a repeat customer!

I was looking for a cooling, calming cream to use after eyebrow waxing. Most calming creams are not to be used around the eyes. This product is perfect. It works gently and is excellent for sensitive skin. It is expensive, but for me, it is worth it. The ingredients are pure and non-irritating. And it can be used all around the eye area. Very pleased with this purchase.
I love this. It moisturises and protects damaged and dry eye lids like nothing else. I trust it.

I am thrilled I tried this eye cream. It's the one I reach for the most in my collection of eye creams. It's very moisturizing and doesn't irritate or cause redness. It sinks in quickly without leaving a surface film. Will purchase again and highly recommend!

avis.auteur: FILO MOLTO UTILE,CON TRE ADATTATORI PER
avis.texte: Utilizzo questo contorno occhi Avène da qualche settimana e sono molto soddisfatto! La texture è leggera e piacevole, si assorbe rapidamente senza lasciare residui. È perfetto per la mia pelle sensibile, non provoca bruciore né irritazioni, anzi dona un immediato senso di freschezza e sollievo. L’ho trovato particolarmente utile nei giorni in cui ho gli occhi stanchi o gonfi: idrata a fondo e attenua visibilmente i segni di stanchezza. Inoltre, è ottimo anche come base trucco. La confezione da 10 ml sembra piccola, ma basta davvero pochissimo prodotto a ogni applicazione, quindi dura molto. Un prodotto delicato ma efficace, consigliatissimo a chi ha occhi sensibili o cerca un trattamento lenitivo di qualità!

It was expired so be careful of the date when your receive it. Update: I received a new item quickly after replacing it and have bought 2 after with no expiration problems. This is the only cream that helps my eyes from redness and eczema!

avis.titre: Healed under eye soreness within days, that Neosporin couldn’t heal.
avis.texte: Sorry about the ugly close ups, but I was just so impressed with this Avene Soothing Eye Contour Cream, and couldn’t keep it to myself. I was starting to think I had some sort of fungus under my eye. It hurt so bad and was so sore that I couldn’t sleep on it because when it touched my pillow it hurt bad. I tried Hyaluronic acid, Neosporin, $79 natural eye moisturizer, and none of it worked. I had this sore for weeks. The last full week, before I ordered this, I used only Neosporin, day and night. After it seemed to spread and get worse, I checked Amazon and saw the good reviews. I was skeptical because of the price. I am so happy I took the chance on this tiny tube of cream. It healed it up pretty much in just a couple days. I am so impressed with this cream, that I am going to be sure to keep some on hand for all sorts of things. If you have a skin issue, please don’t let the price of this cream keep you from getting the relief you deserve.

First of all, I have sensitive eyes and this product has not been triggered it. Theses photos are two month apart and I guess I see improvements. I also feel the skin around my eyes are moisturized. I will but again☺️

Very expensive, but literally the only topical treatment that has helped my atopic dermatitis/eczema. I also change dmy sheets to cotton/silk and stated wearing an eye mask to sleep. Overall I'm really impressed with this product. If you've lost hope, give this a try. Im not sure if I will buy again. There is very little product for the $27.. so I'll probably only purchase again for emergencies. **Edit 5/8/22.. it no longer works so I started using Roc retinol eye cream lancome eye cream (night and day respectively) and those gold eye pads once in a while.. when the eczema flares up I use a baby eczema cream. I stopped using topical steroids as they are messing with my hormones and have other bad side effects. Everything on my bed is silk and it's been a year with maybe one bad flare up. So yeah the original product im reviewing is good for temporary relief but eventually stops working (in my case at least) sorry 😞

avis.titre: Best product for sensitive eyelids/eczema prone skin
avis.texte: I absolutely LOVE this product!! I have always had sensitive skin and eczema on my elbows, but in the last few years the area around my eyes has become unbearably sensitive! I felt like the area around my eyes was burning even when I used dermatologist recommended drug store creams. My only relief was prescription steroid eye drops that my eye doc told me to rub around the outside for relief. With this cream, I’ve been able to stop using the prescription drops and I no longer have swollen reddish eyes and scaly skin! The second picture is before I started using the product and you can see one of the swollen/scaly parts to the right of the picture. The first is the after when it’s no longer an issue! Super excited to continue to use this product.

avis.titre: NOT For Eczema!!! NOT From Amazon!!!
avis.texte: I started having eczema flare ups on my eyelids about a year ago and I purchased this cream after reading a few sources that recommended this skincare line for it (including the Avene site itself). I noticed after a few applications that I would consistently have bad flare ups on my eyelids a few hours after application. Once I stop using the cream and switch to something else, they seems to heal, so I'm confident the cream is the cause. On top of that, Amazon informed me that they do not accept returns on opened cosmetics or skincare products like many other retailers. I would recommend you purchase from a different cosmetic retailer such as Ulta or Sephora if you're just trying this product out since it is pricey. It seemed like a decent eye cream other than the horrible reaction it caused me, so if you don't have an actual skin condition, it may be fine. Overall, extremely disappointed :( UPDATE: I was diagnosed with a fragrance skin allergy, so it was probably the added fragrance in the product. I know this is a common irritant, so I wanted to let people know it is NOT FRAGRANCE FREE.
I literally burst out laughing when I got this. This is literally a SAMPLE size that they are charging a full $30 for. LOL I can’t right now.

Do not buy this product if you have sensitive skin. This burned the skin around my eyes terribly. I only used a little bit and applied far below my eyes. This is not for sensitive skin at all, maybe it works for regular skin?
